status.evidence: Web search summary: "OpenAI announced Sora's discontinuation on March 24, 2026… The Sora web and app experiences were discontinued on April 26, 2026… The Sora API will be discontinued on September 24, 2026"

sources.title: What to know about the Sora discontinuation

nl.tagline: Stopgezet: OpenAI's videogenerator (app gesloten april 2026, API september 2026)
nl.description: Sora was OpenAI's model en app voor het genereren van video uit tekst. OpenAI kondigde op 24 maart 2026 de stopzetting aan: de app en webversie sloten op 26 april 2026 en de API op 24 september 2026. Kies voor nieuwe projecten een actief alternatief.
notFor: Nieuwe projecten: de dienst is stopgezet

en.tagline: Discontinued: OpenAI's video generator (app closed April 2026, API September 2026)
en.description: Sora was OpenAI's text-to-video model and app. OpenAI announced its discontinuation on 24 March 2026: the app and web experience closed on 26 April 2026 and the API on 24 September 2026. Pick an active alternative for new projects.
notFor: New projects: the service has been discontinued
